name: Alabama
alt: A close-up map with a state highlighted that's roughly rectangular, sitting along the Gulf of Mexico with a short stretch of coastline at its southern tip.
facts: This southern state is home to the U.S. Space and Rocket Center, where many astronauts trained.

name: Alaska
alt: A close-up map with a huge highlighted state far in the northwest corner, much bigger than its neighbors and reaching up near the Arctic.
facts: This is the largest state by far, but has fewer people than almost any other state.

name: Arizona
alt: A close-up map with a roughly square highlighted state in the desert southwest, bordered by a long diagonal river along part of its edge.
facts: This state is home to the Grand Canyon, one of the most famous canyons in the world.

name: Arkansas
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a rough rectangle, sitting just west of a big river that forms part of its eastern border.
facts: This is the only U.S. state with a diamond mine where visitors can dig and keep what they find.

name: California
alt: A close-up map with a long, narrow highlighted state running down the entire Pacific coastline.
facts: This is the most populated state, and home to Hollywood, the movie capital of the world.

name: Colorado
alt: A close-up map with a perfectly rectangular highlighted state sitting high in the Rocky Mountains.
facts: This state has the highest average elevation of any state, with many tall mountain peaks.

name: Connecticut
alt: A close-up map with a small highlighted state tucked into the northeast, between bigger neighbors.
facts: This small state is home to one of the oldest universities in the country.

name: Delaware
alt: A close-up map with a tiny, narrow highlighted state along the Atlantic coast, one of the smallest shapes on the map.
facts: This was the very first state to join the United States.

name: Florida
alt: A close-up map with a long highlighted peninsula stretching south into warm waters, with a curved panhandle on its western side.
facts: This state is shaped like a long peninsula and is home to a famous theme park resort.

name: Georgia
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a rough triangle, bordered by ocean on its southeast edge.
facts: This state is the country's top grower of peaches and pecans.

name: Hawaii
alt: A close-up map with a chain of small highlighted islands surrounded entirely by deep blue ocean, far from any other land.
facts: This is the only state made up entirely of islands, far out in the Pacific Ocean.

name: Idaho
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped almost like a boot, narrow at the top and wider toward the bottom.
facts: This state grows more potatoes than any other state in the country.

name: Illinois
alt: A close-up map with a long, narrow highlighted state running north to south, with a big lake along part of its northeastern edge.
facts: This state is home to a city famous for its very tall skyscrapers along a Great Lake.

name: Indiana
alt: A close-up map with a small, roughly rectangular highlighted state nestled between two larger neighbors.
facts: This state hosts one of the most famous car races in the world, held every spring.

name: Iowa
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a rounded square, bordered by rivers on its eastern and western sides.
facts: This state grows more corn than almost any other state.

name: Kansas
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a perfect rectangle, sitting right in the middle of the country.
facts: This state is famous for its wide-open wheat fields and is one of the flattest in the country.

name: Kentucky
alt: A close-up map with a long, narrow highlighted state stretching east to west, with a wavy river border along its north.
facts: This state is famous for raising racehorses and holding a famous derby race each spring.

name: Louisiana
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped a bit like a boot, with a wide river delta fanning out near the coast.
facts: This state's biggest city is famous for jazz music and a colorful Mardi Gras parade.

name: Maine
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state in the far northeast corner, shaped like a rugged, pointed wedge.
facts: This is the easternmost state and catches more lobster than any other.

name: Maryland
alt: A close-up map with a small, oddly shaped highlighted state wrapped around a wide bay, with a thin strip stretching west.
facts: This small state nearly surrounds the nation's capital and has a famous bay full of crabs.

name: Massachusetts
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like an arm, with a curled peninsula reaching out into the Atlantic.
facts: The first Thanksgiving is said to have happened here, where the Pilgrims landed.

name: Michigan
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state split into two separate parts, surrounded by several huge lakes.
facts: This state is shaped like a mitten and touches four of the five Great Lakes.

name: Minnesota
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state near the Canadian border, dotted with thousands of small blue lakes.
facts: This state calls itself the Land of 10,000 Lakes.

name: Mississippi
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a rectangle, with a long river forming its western border.
facts: This state is named after the long river that runs along its western border.

name: Missouri
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped a bit like a boot, sitting in the middle of the country along two major rivers.
facts: This state is home to a giant silver arch standing beside a major river.

name: Montana
alt: A close-up map with a large, roughly rectangular highlighted state along the Canadian border, covered partly by mountains.
facts: This state is nicknamed Big Sky Country for its wide open land and huge skies.

name: Nebraska
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped almost like a rectangle, with a narrow panhandle stretching west.
facts: This state is famous for its wide open plains and cattle ranches.

name: Nevada
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a triangle, mostly covered in dry desert land.
facts: This state is home to a famous city known for its bright lights and big shows.

name: New Hampshire
alt: A close-up map with a small, narrow highlighted state with a short sliver of coastline at its southeastern tip.
facts: This state's motto, carved on its license plates, is 'Live Free or Die.'

name: New Jersey
alt: A close-up map with a small highlighted state squeezed between two big bays, shaped a bit like a flattened triangle.
facts: This small but crowded state is nicknamed the Garden State.

name: New Mexico
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped almost like a rectangle, covered in desert in the southwest.
facts: This state is home to a desert covered in brilliant white sand dunes.

name: New York
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped a bit like an arrowhead, with a long thin panhandle on its eastern side.
facts: This state's biggest city has a famous statue standing in its harbor.

name: North Carolina
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state stretching from inland mountains to a curving string of barrier islands on the coast.
facts: Two brothers flew the first airplane on the sandy beaches of this state.

name: North Dakota
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a perfect rectangle, sitting right along the Canadian border.
facts: This state lies along the Canadian border and is one of the least visited in the country.

name: Ohio
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped a bit like a kite, with a curving lake along its northern edge.
facts: This state is home to a famous music hall of fame beside one of the Great Lakes.

name: Oklahoma
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a pot with a long handle, called its panhandle, sticking out to the west.
facts: This state's name comes from Choctaw words meaning 'red people.'

name: Oregon
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a near-perfect rectangle along the Pacific coastline.
facts: This state has a coastline along the Pacific Ocean and is famous for its rainy, green forests.

name: Pennsylvania
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a rectangle, with a tiny sliver of lakeshore along its northwestern corner.
facts: This state is where the Declaration of Independence was signed, in one of its biggest cities.

name: Rhode Island
alt: A close-up map with a tiny highlighted state, the smallest shape of all its neighbors, wrapped around a narrow bay.
facts: This is the smallest state in the entire country by area.

name: South Carolina
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a triangle, with a curved coastline along the Atlantic.
facts: The first shots of the Civil War were fired here, at a fort in its harbor.

name: South Dakota
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a rectangle, split by a wide river running north to south.
facts: This state is home to a mountain with four presidents' faces carved into it.

name: Tennessee
alt: A close-up map with a long, narrow highlighted state stretching east to west, much wider than it is tall.
facts: This state's capital city is famous as the home of country music.

name: Texas
alt: A close-up map with a huge highlighted state shaped a bit like a thick arrowhead, much larger than all its neighbors.
facts: This is the second-biggest state by both size and population.

name: Utah
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped almost like a rectangle, with a notch cut out of its northeastern corner.
facts: This state is home to five national parks full of red rock canyons and arches.

name: Vermont
alt: A close-up map with a small, narrow highlighted state wedged between bigger neighbors, with no coastline at all.
facts: This state is one of the top producers of maple syrup in the country.

name: Virginia
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a triangle with a thin peninsula reaching out toward the Atlantic.
facts: Many early U.S. presidents were born in this state, earning it a famous nickname.

name: Washington
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state in the far northwest corner, with a deeply notched coastline and a large inland sound.
facts: This state is home to a huge snow-capped volcano that towers over a nearby city.

name: West Virginia
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like an odd zigzag, with no straight borders at all.
facts: This state is covered almost entirely by a long mountain range.

name: Wisconsin
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a mitten's thumb, bordered by a huge lake on its east.
facts: This state produces more cheese than any other state in the country.

name: Wyoming
alt: A close-up map with a highlighted state shaped like a perfect rectangle, sitting high in the Rocky Mountains.
facts: This state is home to the first national park ever created.
